companyFocus.name: Roborock
companyFocus.role: Consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch165. Roborock pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. Saros 10, Qrevo Edge, Qrevo Slim and Saros 10R are four separate current models. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Roborock is a consumer cleaning and floor-care robot manufacturer whose reviewed US range includes the Saros 10, Saros 10R, Qrevo Edge and Qrevo Slim.
The reviewed pages publish 11,000 Pa suction for the Qrevo Slim, 18,500 Pa for the Qrevo Edge and 22,000 Pa for the Saros 10, with HyperForce and dual anti-tangle brush systems.
Battery capacity is 5,200 mAh for the Qrevo Slim and 6,400 mAh for the Saros 10, Qrevo Edge and Saros 10R; the Saros 10 and Saros 10R pages cite 2.5-hour fast charging.
The Saros 10 page publishes 52 dB(A) in quiet mopping and 72 dB(A) dock self-emptying, and the Qrevo Edge page 55 dB mopping with 75 C mop washing.
The reviewed pages publish no full-charge runtime, payload or IP rating; robot mass figures of 8.6, 9.04 and 36.38 lbs remain separate from the catalog values.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: Saros 10, Qrevo Edge, Qrevo Slim and Saros 10R are four separate current Roborock robot vacuum models, not tiers or cut-down versions of one another.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: The reviewed US pages publish 1,299.99 USD against a 1,599.99 USD list price for the Saros 10, 1,599.99 USD for the Qrevo Edge, 1,399.99 USD for the Qrevo Slim and 1,099.99 USD against a 1,599.99 USD list price for the Saros 10R. The catalog values of 1,600, 1,599, 1,400 and 1,600 USD are not the current published prices.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: The Qrevo Edge page publishes 8.6 lbs (3.9 kg), which agrees with the catalog 3.9 kg. The Saros 10 and Saros 10R pages publish 9.04 lbs or 36.38 lbs values that conflict with the catalog 4.1 kg, and the Qrevo Slim page publishes 9.04 lbs against the catalog 5 kg. The differing values stay visible.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: The Saros 10 page publishes 350 x 353 x 79.8 mm with the LDS retracted, the Qrevo Edge 13.9 x 13.7 x 4.1 in and the Qrevo Slim 13.78 x 13.9 x 3.23 in, each with separate dock dimensions. The Saros 10R page publishes an internally inconsistent 10.40 x 9.38 x 43.63 in robot dimension string, so no robot dimension is recorded.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed Roborock page publishes a payload rating; these are floor-cleaning robots without a manipulator or load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: No reviewed page publishes a full-charge runtime in minutes. The Saros 10 page publishes 22,000 Pa and 52 dB(A) in quiet mopping, the Qrevo Edge 18,500 Pa and 55 dB, and the Qrevo Slim 11,000 Pa. Battery capacity is 6,400 mAh for the Saros 10, Qrevo Edge and Saros 10R and 5,200 mAh for the Qrevo Slim. The catalog 240 min Qrevo Edge runtime is cleared.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Roborock describes StarSight, 3D ToF navigation, VertiBeam lateral obstacle avoidance and AdaptiLift chassis. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.
